selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) use during pregnancy
Prior or current untreated psychiatric illness
outcome: Postpartum haemorrhage (PPH) defined as blood loss >1000 ml during the first 2 hours postpartum
cohort: 31,159 pregnant women with singleton deliveries after gestational week 22(+0) between January 2013 and July 2017 in Sweden
finding: Both SSRI use during pregnancy and a prior or current history of psychiatric illness were associated with an increased likelihood of PPH.
mod_finding: Women treated with SSRI during pregnancy and women with prior or current psychiatric illness had a higher risk for postpartum hemorrhage.
